Chapter 7058: How Did You Let Go?

Chapter 7058: How Did You Let Go?

The glorious force of the past was obliterated in the blink of an eye. Remember, they dared to fight the high heaven.

“Unbeatable...” Some spectators sat on the ground, feeling hopeless.

They thought they were looking at another high heaven. One was impossible enough, now another?

“No one but the high heaven can do this.” A golden immortal said in a daze.

“Can’t be another one, the actual won’t permit his existence.” A peer shook her head.

“Perhaps this is a celestial immortal with apex power?” Another found this logical.

“This is beyond apex power, something greater.” Heaven’s Equal said.

“A higher realm than apex?” Others haven’t heard of this before.

“Letting go.” Zhao Dachui said: “This is Octopus and Hidden Immortal’s level.”

“Letting go?” Others heard him and discussed among themselves. They only knew about the apex power within the celestial realm.

“It should be the door to the high heaven’s level.” Heaven’s Equal speculated.

“How many have reached it?” Another asked. Previously, they thought apex was the limit.

They knew about Heavenfall, Dusk, and a few more. What was this about Octopus and Hidden Immortal?

Only a few had heard of these mysterious beings due to having connections with the celestial immortals.

“The masterminds behind Immortal Hunt and Heaven Essence Alliance, Heaven Pit was their plan.” A golden immortal whispered.

“They dared to scheme against the high heaven. Perhaps they will appear soon.” Heaven’s Equal said, aware that these beings could actually challenge the high heaven.

They baited the high heaven to Ruin, hoping to end this existence there.

All eyes were on Zhao Dachui and Li Qiye upon hearing about this so-called “letting go” realm.

“How did you do it?” Zhao Dachui stared at Li Qiye in disbelief.

“I just let go, it’s that simple. What else can it be, holding on?” Li Qiye waved his hand.

Zhao Dachui had no response, unable to accept this answer. He cultivated his whole life and even deliberately fell into the darkness, unable to obtain a paramita body.

This man was a junior from a minor world, far younger than most immortals. It was one thing for Octopus or Hidden Immortal to let go, but him?

Zhao Dachui had never cared about tiny worlds. They could only produce emperors and overlords at best. Alas, in recent years, the mortals from there had somehow surpassed them.

Spectators listened attentively, hoping to find more information about this new stage.

“Crackle!” Suddenly, flames and lightning surged again in the ocean and materialized into the dead cultivators.

“It’s them again!” One cultivator shouted.

“How can this be?” Eyes widened at this sight.

They witnessed the horde’s destruction just moments ago but now, they were back.

“Is this infinite rebirth?” No one had an answer.

“Inconceivable.” Heaven’s Equal couldn’t believe his eyes.
